benchmarks.question: Median and P90 days to go live by booking country and request month, for live cases requested since April 2025, with the number of live cases.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
SELECT `Booking Country`, `Month` AS request_month,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Date` >= :from_month AND `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Booking Country`, request_month
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Booking Country`, `Month` AS request_month,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Date` >= DATE'2025-04-01' AND `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Booking Country`, request_month

benchmarks.question: Median and P90 days to go live by KYC migration period, with the number of live cases.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
SELECT
  `KYC Migration Period` AS `kyc_migration_period`,
  MEASURE(`Live Cases`) AS `live_cases`,
  MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS `median_days_to_live`,
  MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`) AS `p90_days_to_live`
FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_cycle_time`
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Live'
  AND `KYC Migration Period` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN `kyc_migration_period` = 'Pre-migration' THEN 1
  WHEN `kyc_migration_period` = 'Migration (Feb-2026)' THEN 2
  WHEN `kyc_migration_period` = 'Backlog peak (Mar-May 2026)' THEN 3
  WHEN `kyc_migration_period` = 'Recovery (from Jun-2026)' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `KYC Migration Period`,
       MEASURE(`Live Cases`)          AS live_cases,
       MEASURE(`Median Days to Live`) AS median_days_to_live,
       MEASURE(`P90 Days to Live`)    AS p90_days_to_live
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
WHERE `Case Status` = 'Live'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY median_days_to_live

benchmarks.question: Which onboarding stage adds the most days for Financial Institution clients, and did it change after February 2026? Show the average days in each stage (stages 1-6) for requests before February 2026 and from February 2026.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH st AS (
  SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`, `Is After KYC Migration`, MEASURE(`Average Days in Stage`) AS avg_days_in_stage
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
  WHERE `Request Segment` = :request_segment AND `Stage Number` <= 6
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`,
       max(CASE WHEN NOT `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END) AS avg_days_before_feb_2026,
       max(CASE WHEN `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END)     AS avg_days_from_feb_2026
FROM st
GROUP BY `Stage Number`, `Stage`
ORDER BY `Stage Number`
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH st AS (
  SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`, `Is After KYC Migration`, MEASURE(`Average Days in Stage`) AS avg_days_in_stage
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_cycle_time
  WHERE `Request Segment` = 'Financial Institution' AND `Stage Number` <= 6
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Stage Number`, `Stage`,
       max(CASE WHEN NOT `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END) AS avg_days_before_feb_2026,
       max(CASE WHEN `Is After KYC Migration` THEN avg_days_in_stage END)     AS avg_days_from_feb_2026
FROM st
GROUP BY `Stage Number`, `Stage`
ORDER BY `Stage Number`

benchmarks.question: What share of new onboarding cases was matched to an existing client group? Break it down by match timing with cases, share of all cases, live cases and share of all live cases (shares as fractions).
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    `Match Timing`,
    MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS `cases`,
    MEASURE(`Cases Live`) AS `live_cases`
  FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_funnel`
  WHERE `Match Timing` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT
  `Match Timing` AS `match_timing`,
  `cases`,
  try_divide(`cases`,SUM(`cases`) OVER ()) AS `share_of_all_cases`,
  `live_cases`,
  try_divide(`live_cases`,SUM(`live_cases`) OVER ()) AS `share_of_all_live_cases`
FROM base
ORDER BY `cases` DESC, `match_timing`
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT `Match Timing`, MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS cases, MEASURE(`Cases Live`) AS live_cases
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Match Timing`, cases, cases / SUM(cases) OVER () AS share_of_cases,
       live_cases, live_cases / SUM(live_cases) OVER () AS share_of_live_cases
FROM m
ORDER BY cases DESC

benchmarks.question: Which onboarding cases were matched to their client group only after account opening? Show client, client group, booking country, request date and the number of such cases.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
SELECT
  `Client` AS `client`,
  `Client Group` AS `client_group`,
  `Booking Country` AS `booking_country`,
  `Date` AS `request_date`,
  MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS `number_of_cases`
FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_funnel`
WHERE `Match Timing` = 'After Account Opening'
  AND `Client` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Client Group` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Booking Country` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Date` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) > 0
ORDER BY `number_of_cases` DESC, `request_date` ASC, `client` ASC, `client_group` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Client`, `Client Group`, `Booking Country`, `Date` AS request_date,
       MEASURE(`Matched After Account Opening`) AS cases
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Match Timing` = 'After Account Opening'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Matched After Account Opening`) > 0
ORDER BY request_date

benchmarks.question: Onboarding requests by request segment and product requested: FY2026 H1 vs FY2025 H1, and full-year FY2025.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`, `Fiscal Year`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Product Requests`) AS requests
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` IN (:fiscal_year, :prior_fiscal_year)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = CONCAT(:fiscal_year, '-H1') THEN requests ELSE 0 END)       AS fytd_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = CONCAT(:prior_fiscal_year, '-H1') THEN requests ELSE 0 END) AS prior_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Year` = :prior_fiscal_year THEN requests ELSE 0 END)                AS prior_full_year_requests
FROM p
WHERE `Product Requested` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY fytd_h1_requests DESC, prior_full_year_requests DESC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Product Requests`) AS requests
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` IN ('FY2025', 'FY2026')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Product Requested`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2026-H1' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)           AS fy2026_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2025-H1' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)           AS fy2025_h1_requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` LIKE 'FY2025-%' THEN requests ELSE 0 END)         AS fy2025_full_year_requests
FROM p
WHERE `Product Requested` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY fy2026_h1_requests DESC, fy2025_full_year_requests DESC

benchmarks.question: Onboarding cases opened by request segment, primary product and fiscal half for FY2025-H1 and FY2026-H1 - one row per segment, product and half.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
SELECT
  `Request Segment` AS `request_segment`,
  `Primary Product` AS `primary_product`,
  `Fiscal Half` AS `fiscal_half`,
  MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS `cases_opened`
FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_funnel`
WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN ('FY2025-H1', 'FY2026-H1')
  AND `Request Segment` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Primary Product` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Fiscal Half` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `request_segment` ASC, `primary_product` ASC, `fiscal_half` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Request Segment`, `Primary Product`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Cases Opened`) AS requests
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN ('FY2025-H1', 'FY2026-H1')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Request Segment`, `Primary Product`, `Fiscal Half`

benchmarks.question: Which clients onboarded in FY2026 have not transacted within 60 days of go-live? Show client, booking country, the number of such cases and the average days to first transaction.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
SELECT
  `Client` AS `client`,
  `Booking Country` AS `booking_country`,
  MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`) AS `cases_not_transacted_within_60d`,
  MEASURE(`Average First Transaction Lag Days`) AS `average_days_to_first_transaction`
FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_funnel`
WHERE `Go-Live Fiscal Year` = 'FY2026'
  AND `Client` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Booking Country` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`) > 0
ORDER BY `cases_not_transacted_within_60d` DESC, `client` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Client`, `Booking Country`,
       MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`)          AS not_transacted_within_60d,
       MEASURE(`Average First Transaction Lag Days`) AS days_to_first_transaction
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
WHERE `Go-Live Fiscal Year` = 'FY2026'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Not Transacted Within 60D`) > 0
ORDER BY days_to_first_transaction DESC

benchmarks.question: high-risk CDD backlog: periodic KYC refreshes overdue at each month-end since Apr-25 vs total periodic overdue
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH `base` AS (
  SELECT
    `Month`,
    `Client Risk Rating`,
    MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS `overdue_reviews`
  FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_kyc_health`
  WHERE `Record Type` = 'Review Snapshot'
    AND `Review Type` = 'Periodic'
    AND `Month` >= DATE '2025-04-01'
    AND `Month` IS NOT NULL
    AND `Client Risk Rating` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING MEASURE(`Overdue`) > 0
)
SELECT
  `Month`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `Client Risk Rating` = 'High' THEN `overdue_reviews` ELSE 0 END) AS `high_risk_periodic_overdue`,
  SUM(`overdue_reviews`) AS `total_periodic_overdue`
FROM `base`
GROUP BY `Month`
ORDER BY `Month` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Month`, MEASURE(`High-Risk Overdue`) AS high_risk_overdue, MEASURE(`Overdue`) AS all_overdue
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_kyc_health
WHERE `Review Type` = 'Periodic' AND `Month` >= DATE'2025-04-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Month`

benchmarks.question: what are clients complaining about after onboarding? rank the negative comment themes
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH `theme_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `Feedback Theme`,
    MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) AS `negative_responses`
  FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_onboarding_funnel`
  WHERE `Feedback Theme` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) > 0
), `ranked` AS (
  SELECT
    `Feedback Theme`,
    `negative_responses`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `negative_responses` DESC, `Feedback Theme` ASC) AS `rank`
  FROM `theme_counts`
)
SELECT
  `rank`,
  `Feedback Theme`,
  `negative_responses`
FROM `ranked`
ORDER BY `rank` ASC, `Feedback Theme` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT `Feedback Theme`, MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) AS negative_responses
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_onboarding_funnel
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`Negative Responses`) > 0
ORDER BY negative_responses DESC
